My name is not important, but let me think through this year.

I have 50 mu — that is a big piece of land for our village. With 7 people in the house and some working outside, I mostly manage it myself with my wife, and I hire help at harvest and sowing. The wheat-maize rotation is what everyone does here in Quzhou, and I have done it for 30 years. I won't change the system.

**Winter wheat (50 mu):**
Last year I got about 500 kg/mu. I plant Jimai 22 — the seed dealer in town sells it, neighbors use it, yield is stable. I buy improved seed, not saving my own, because the dealer's seed germinates better.

For fertilizer, I use compound 15-15-15 as base, about 50 kg per mu before sowing. That gives me 7.5 kg each of N, P, K. Then I topdress urea at jointing — one bag (40 kg) covers about 2.5 mu, so about 16 kg urea per mu = 7.3 kg N. Total N around 15 kg/mu, P around 7.5, K around 7.5. I know some say this is too much P but compound fertilizer is convenient and neighbors do the same.

Irrigation: I water before winter (dong shui), then at jointing and at grain filling. Three times. Well water is available so I don't skip.

Pesticide: herbicide in spring once, and one spray against aphids and powdery mildew around heading. Two applications.

Tillage: rotary till after maize harvest — everyone does rotary now, ploughing is too expensive and slow.

**Summer maize (50 mu):**
After wheat I plant Zhengdan 958 or similar — hybrid seed, I buy fresh every year. Last year maize gave me about 550 kg/mu.

Fertilizer: I apply compound 15-15-15 at sowing, 40 kg/mu (6 kg each NPK). Then topdress urea at big trumpet stage, about 20 kg urea/mu = 9 kg N. Total N around 15 kg, P 6, K 6. Maize responds to nitrogen, so I don't skimp.

Irrigation: usually rain covers most of it in Hebei summer, but if dry at tasseling I water once. Plan for 1 time.

Pesticide: one spray for corn borer at whorl stage, maybe a second if armyworm shows up. Plan for 2.

Tillage: no-tillage direct seeding into wheat stubble — saves time because the turnaround between wheat harvest and maize sowing is only a few days.
